messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a microblast for RN 3.4.1. Target change window Tue 09:00 PT. Need: short internal announce, version pin, canary lanes, and rollback criteria. @mira can you own the release-note microcopy? @jordan ops standby?

mira: Yep I can grab microcopy. Want a 2–3 bullet TL;DR + one line for impact/rollback. Any headline phrasing preference?

jordan: Ops standby. Quick Q: are we pinning the SDK + runtime, or only server-side model? Need to know rollback surface.

alex: Pin both runtime and model variant to 3.4.1 for the blast (customer-facing host). We'll keep telemetry flag to enable fast rollback. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% by success gates.

sam (deploybot): Preflight checks started for release: 3.4.1
```
Checks summary:
- infra health: OK
- db migrations: NONE
- smoke tests: 12/12 PASS
- canary hooks: configured
- quota checks: OK
```

lee: Rollback thresholds suggestion: error-rate > 1.5x baseline for 5m or latency p95 > 2x baseline for 5m triggers abort. Also add automatic fallback to 3.4.0 variant on abort.

mira: Draft microcopy (short):
```
Release 3.4.1 — micro-optimizations to batching and runtime kernels; reduces tail latency for short prompts by ~12%. No customer-visible API changes. Pin: 3.4.1. Rollback: automatic fallback to 3.4.0 if canary error-rate increases >50% vs baseline.
```

alex: Nice, tweak the rollback sentence to say "fallback to 3.4.0 and disable new kernel path". Also include a one-line exec summary for the internal announce: "Performance-focused microblast; minimal risk; canary-first rollout."

jordan: Ops runbook snippet (copy/paste):
```
# Pin version
curl -X POST https://internal-api/release/pin -d '{"service":"inference","version":"3.4.1"}'
# Abort and rollback
deploybot abort --release 17686 && deploybot rollback --target 3.4.0
```

sam (deploybot): Scheduled rollout: Tue 2026-03-24 09:00 PT -> canary 5% (30m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100% (gradual). Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.internal/rollouts/17686

lee: LGTM. I'll own first 30m monitoring and escalation. On-call: @jordan if we hit thresholds, escalate to @alex & @mira.

mira: I'll post the internal announce + attach RN snippet to the eng-releases pinned thread by EOD today. Will include the pin line and the rollback bullets. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — please tag #all-hands-announce when you post so comms can copy the short line. If anything changes we abort the schedule and regroup.

jordan: Noted. I'll stage alert dashboards and notify SRE on standby.

sam (deploybot): Reminder: add `pin_version: "3.4.1"` to release manifest before 08:30 PT on rollout day.

mira: Got it, will attach final RN + manifest snippet.

alex: Great. Closing here — final signoff in this thread when RN posted.
